title: Meet Sammy the Sloth
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Meet Sammy the Sloth! Sammy lives high in the trees of the rainforest in Central and South America.
Sammy is one of the slowest animals in the world. He moves so slowly that tiny green plants grow in his fur!
The green in his fur helps him hide in the leaves. Can you find Sammy? He looks like part of the tree.
Sammy hangs upside down with long, curved claws. He eats upside down and sleeps upside down, too.
Sammy eats leaves, leaves, and more leaves. His tummy works so slowly that one meal can take days to digest.
About once a week, Sammy climbs all the way down to the ground to go potty. It is a very, very long trip.
By the time he climbs back to the top, he says, "Was that a long trip, or am I just slow?"
Jaguars hunt on the ground, and big harpy eagles hunt from the sky. Sammy's best trick is to stay still and stay green.
Here is a surprise: sloths are good swimmers! In the water, Sammy moves much faster than he does in the trees.
Sloths like to live alone. A baby sloth rides on its mom's tummy for months, until it is ready to climb by itself.
